newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active on Thursday, according to USDA. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher than Tuesday. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 19,900 slaughter steers and 19,500 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 60,500 head confirmed including 16,300 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1325 lbs 66.00; couple pens Select with end Choice 65.00; pen Select and Choice 1310 lb cutting bulls 64.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 1175-1210 lbs 106.00.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1200 lbs 66.00; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1240 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.00. Dressed Basis - Select and Choice 1050 lbs 106.00, hot weights, delivered.
Wk to date - 60,500 week ago - 91,100 year ago - 85,700
